name: answer-feed
description: Validate merchant-authored product facts and prepare reviewed Merchant Center supplemental TSV files.

interface.longDescription: Check exact product IDs, authored answers, PDF links and variant consistency. Return a reviewed supplemental TSV for manual Merchant Center upload. Checks do not verify product claims, document access, Google ingestion or visibility.
defaultPrompt: Validate my authored Merchant Center product answers against these primary product IDs.
Prepare a supplemental TSV from these five reviewed products and selected attributes.
